candidates.verbatim_passage: The most important exposure element when assessing the spread of an exterior fire is the climate. This element can be divided in two: first, by assessing the severity and frequency of forest and wildland fires, e.g. by looking at forest or wildland fire risk indexes like the Canadian Forest Fire Weather Index [20], and second, by assessing the probability of challenging wind speeds.
